posts.title: Xiaomi EV delivers 31,267 units in July, 39% of annual target
posts.summary:
Xiaomi EV needs average monthly deliveries of nearly 67,000 units over the remaining 5 months to achieve its full-year target of 550,000 units.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Xiaomi EV delivered 31,267 units in July, marking four consecutive months above the 30,000-unit threshold but representing a 9.99% month-on-month decline.
The company has only reached 39% of its 550,000-unit annual delivery target, requiring a significant ramp-up to an average of 67,000 units per month for the remainder of the year.
Growth prospects now hinge on the new Sky Nomad EREV series, which is positioned to compete directly with Li Auto and Huawei-backed Aito at aggressive price points.

posts.title: Chengdu Auto Show opens next week with nearly 120 brands, 1,600 vehicles
posts.summary:
The 2026 Chengdu Auto Show will cover 220,000 square meters, making it China's first A-level show of the second half of the year.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: The 2026 Chengdu Auto Show, China's first A-level event of the second half, will feature nearly 120 brands and 1,600 vehicles across 220,000 square meters.
Major manufacturers are using the event to debut key products, including BYD's D-segment flagship sedan, Huawei's new Maextro MPVs, and Xiaomi's extended-range SUV series.
The show serves as a critical barometer for southwestern Chinese market demand and a strategic launchpad for automakers ahead of the peak autumn sales season.

posts.title: Hyundai's first Ioniq model for China to open pre-sales at Chengdu Auto Show
posts.summary:
The Ioniq V is the first production model in China from Hyundai's electric brand Ioniq, and will officially launch in September.
For details, please visit CnEVPost (cnev.co).
bullets: Beijing Hyundai will open pre-sales for the Ioniq V, its first China-produced Ioniq model, at the Chengdu Auto Show with an official launch scheduled for September.
The mid-size electric sedan is built on the E-GMP platform and features high-end tech integration, including a Qualcomm Snapdragon 8295 chip and AI models from Baidu and ByteDance.
Developed by Hyundai's China design center, the vehicle is specifically tailored for the local market but is also slated for future global export.

posts.title: Scaling AI agents with trustworthy data
posts.summary: Business and technology leaders need no convincing that the time of agentic AI is here. Organizations are rapidly adopting agents, and few executives doubt the technology’s potential to transform work. But many organizations find that realizing the desired return on investment (ROI) from AI hinges on having the right foundation, with inadequate infrastructure and data…
bullets: Enterprise AI agents currently have access to an average of only 45% of organizational data, creating a significant bottleneck for autonomous decision-making.
Gartner predicts that AI agents will automate or augment 50% of business decisions by 2027, necessitating a shift away from restrictive legacy data architectures.
Data leaders who provide agents with access to over 70% of enterprise information report higher ROI and greater success in deploying autonomous systems compared to data laggards.
Effective agentic AI requires frictionless, real-time integration across structured and unstructured data sources, including supply chain and HR operational systems.

posts.title: Standards-Compliant 112G PHY for Linear Optics: Driving Efficient AI Infrastructure
posts.summary:
112G PHY IP for linear optics to reduce power, latency and thermal load for high-speed data movement in AI and data center systems.
The post Standards-Compliant 112G PHY for Linear Optics: Driving Efficient AI Infrastructure appeared first on Semiconductor Engineering.
bullets: Synopsys has introduced the industry's first 112G PHY IP compliant with the OIF-CEI-112G-LINEAR-PAM4 standard, designed to facilitate DSP-less host-to-module connectivity.
Transitioning to linear optics can reduce module power consumption by up to 50%, significantly lowering thermal loads in high-density AI data center racks.
By eliminating the need for power-hungry DSPs and retimers, this technology addresses critical bottlenecks in scaling AI interconnects beyond 800G.
The new PHY IP provides a scalable foundation for future high-speed architectures, including 224G/448G data rates and Co-Packaged Optics (CPO) implementations.
